questions.questionEn: What time does the shadow on the giant sundial, the Samrat Yantra, show?

options.textEn: Indian Standard Time, the same as a mobile phone.
The local time, set by the sun's position over Jaipur.
London time, for the British officials of the past.

vocabularyJa.meaning: 地方時（その土地の太陽による時刻）

questions.hintJa: 日時計が知っているのは、頭の上の太陽だけ。
questions.correctExplanationJa: サムラート・ヤントラの影が示すのは、ジャイプールの太陽の位置で決まる地方時です。国全体で使う標準時とは別のものです。
questions.incorrectExplanationJa: 日時計が示すのは、その土地の太陽による地方時です。携帯の標準時とも、ロンドンの時刻とも違います。

sources.title: Samrat Yantra
sources.claimJa: 晴れた日、日時計の指針の影が四分円の目盛りに落ちて、地方時を示す。

A2.questionEn: What time does the shadow on the very big sundial, the Samrat Yantra, show?

options.textEn: Indian Standard Time, the same time as on a mobile phone.
The local time. It comes from where the sun is over Jaipur.
London time, for the British officials long ago.

vocabularyJa.meaning: 地方時（その土地の太陽による時刻）

B2.questionEn: Which time is indicated by the shadow cast on the giant sundial known as the Samrat Yantra?

options.textEn: Indian Standard Time, identical to that displayed on a mobile phone.
Local solar time, determined by the sun's position above Jaipur.
London time, for the benefit of British officials in former times.

questions.questionEn: How precisely can Jaipur's Samrat Yantra measure time?

options.textEn: To about two seconds.
Only to the nearest hour.
Only whether it is morning or afternoon.

questions.hintJa: 装置が巨大なのは、目盛りを細かく刻むため。
questions.correctExplanationJa: ジャイプールのサムラート・ヤントラは、時刻を約二秒の精度で測ることができます。巨大な大きさが、細かな目盛りを可能にしました。
questions.incorrectExplanationJa: 精度は約二秒です。大きな日時計ほど影の動きが目に見えやすく、細かく刻めます。

sources.title: Samrat Yantra
sources.claimJa: ジャイプールのサムラート・ヤントラは、時刻を二秒の精度で測ることができる。

A2.questionEn: How exact is the time on Jaipur's Samrat Yantra?

options.textEn: To about two seconds.
Only to the nearest hour.
It only tells you if it is morning or afternoon.

B2.questionEn: To what degree of precision can Jaipur's Samrat Yantra measure time?

options.textEn: To within roughly two seconds.
Merely to the nearest hour.
Only well enough to distinguish morning from afternoon.

questions.questionEn: At twelve o'clock by Divya's phone, the shadow has not reached the noon line. Why?

options.textEn: The sundial has been broken since the early 1900s.
The shadow only moves correctly when the moon is up.
To get standard time, you must correct for the difference in longitude and the time of year.

questions.hintJa: 国中が同じ時計を使っても、太陽が真南に来る時刻は、東と西で違う。
questions.correctExplanationJa: 日時計の地方時を標準時に直すには、経度の差と、季節による日々のずれを補正する式を使います。ジャイプールは標準時の基準より西にあるため、太陽が南中するのは時計の正午より遅くなります。
questions.incorrectExplanationJa: 日時計は壊れていません。地方時から標準時を求めるには、経度の差と季節のずれを補正する必要があります。

sources.title: Samrat Yantra
sources.claimJa: 標準時を得るには、経度の差と、地球の公転による日々の調整を補う式を用いる。

A2.questionEn: It is twelve o'clock on Divya's phone, but the shadow is not at the noon line yet. Why?

options.textEn: The sundial has been broken since the early 1900s.
The shadow only moves the right way when the moon is in the sky.
You must change the sundial's time to get the phone's time. The change depends on where Jaipur is and on the time of year.

B2.questionEn: Divya's phone reads twelve o'clock, yet the shadow has still not reached the noon line. How can this be explained?

options.textEn: The sundial has been out of order since the early twentieth century.
The shadow only behaves correctly while the moon is visible.
Converting to standard time requires an adjustment for longitude and for the time of year.
